sgtconti_clouds_background.name: Clouds Background
sgtconti_clouds_background.description: Procedural drifting cloud background with adjustable density, scale, wind, sky tint and opacity. Supports WebGL and WebGPU.

scale.name: Scale
scale.desc: Cloud coordinate scale using the original version's behavior.

speedX.name: Wind X
speedX.desc: Horizontal drift speed in pixels per second.

speedY.name: Wind Y
speedY.desc: Vertical drift speed in pixels per second.

skyTint.name: Sky tint
skyTint.desc: How much the sky gradient tints the clouds.

skyTop.name: Sky top color
skyTop.desc: Top color of the sky gradient.

skyBottom.name: Sky bottom color
skyBottom.desc: Bottom color of the sky gradient.

mask.name: Only on transparent
mask.desc: 0 = full rectangle. 100 = render only where the layer/object is transparent.

maskInv.name: Legacy mask A
maskInv.desc: Compatibility parameter retained from the original version.

maskinv.name: Legacy mask B
maskinv.desc: Compatibility parameter retained from the original version.
